crossRefs.note: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body…
crossRefs.keyword: the dirt came out. or, it came out at the fundament

translations.web: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
translations.bsb: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and Eglon’s fat closed in over it, so that Ehud did not withdraw the sword from his belly. And Eglon’s bowels emptied.
translations.kjv: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
translations.asv: and the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, for he drew not the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
